notes.title: Golf With Your Friends 2 Release Plans Update 🏌️⛳
notes.notes: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11421109/052358d01a3deb73f06ee767b425401ffe439a1e.png"][/img][/p][h3]Golfers! Back in December, we announced Golf With Your Friends 2! Since then our development team, [b]Radical Forge[/b], have been hard at work building the game from the ground up in a new engine. Our goal with the sequel is to make the best possible Golf With Your Friends game we can and that means that we've had to make a few difficult decisions along the way.[/h3][p][/p][h2]That is to say that we've decided to move away from an Early Access release on Steam, and instead [b]launch Golf With Your Friends 2 as a full release across all platforms in 2026[/b].[/h2][p][/p][h3]This wasn't an easy decision, but it's one that gives us the freedom to make sure the sequel releases with all the polish, content and chaos that you expect from a Golf With Your Friends game![/h3][h3]We appreciate your patience and support as we keep working on Golf With Your Friends 2! We'll have lots more to share over the coming months, including full course reveals and behind the scenes content! Keep an eye out for the [b]Skate Park course showcase [/b]soon![/h3][p][/p][p][b]Keep up to date with Golf With Your Friends 2 by following the [url="https://x.com/GolfWYF"]official X account[/url], joining the [url="https://discord.gg/xDvaNtC2ga"]Golf With Your Friends Discord[/url], and wishlisting on Steam![/b][/p][p][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3209660/Golf_With_Your_Friends_2/"][/dynamiclink][/p]
